clarifiedScope: First printed Fatiha ayah: الحمد through العالمين, its body marks and five upper annotations.
sourceFeatures: Wedge-shaped sukun, unlike Amiri round sukun.
Extended near-horizontal baseline and source-specific joined forms.
Ba dot distinct from lower kasra in rabb.
Nun dot inside bowl of final nun.
Five upper annotation shapes from RTL: one-like mark, Bengali ma, one-like mark, conditional hooked bowl, oval-enclosed wedge.
requirements: Match exact underlying Unicode source strings; no hidden transcript overlay.
Font must remain gated to four approved contexts.
No raster/svg/canvas content for actual words.
Inspect ligature whole-word selection; do not claim per-letter caret or verified letter anchors.
Upper annotation fraction positions are provisional even if fixed relative to a whole word.
